title: Payment status handling
content: If a pacs.002 status is RJCT or PDNG, the case must not be auto-cleared until the rejection or pending reason is reviewed.

title: Amount limit review
content: Payments above the configured amount threshold require analyst review when combined with missing beneficiary, duplicate, or status mismatch indicators.

title: Duplicate payment control
content: Duplicate payment signals require evidence of unique payment identifiers before auto-resolution.

title: Customer impact handling
content: Customer-impacting payment delays should be routed to analyst review when there is weak evidence or conflicting status information.

title: Compliance action gate
content: Compliance review is required before any block or escalation action if the case contains manual compliance review flags.

title: Evidence sufficiency
content: If required evidence slots are missing, the assistant must abstain from final resolution and route the case to human review.
